items.reason: The newly added ClientPermissionsV2.java:214-224 selects the all-clients resource only when the target client's resource is absent; otherwise it evaluates only that client's resource and returns false without a global fallback (line 234). AdminPermissionsSchema.java:103-110 creates individual resources without a type, so DefaultPolicyEvaluator.java:70-87 does not automatically include the all-clients resource's policies. Consequently, a legitimate global manage/configure grant can stop working when a separate permission creates a resource for that client.
